# Create a team space

## What to build

Add the ability to create a **team space**: a new space that lives in its own new `Organization`, starts empty, and has the creator as `owner`. This slice adds `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`), the `spaces.createTeam` oRPC procedure, exposes `kind` and the caller's `role` on `SpaceSchema`, makes the sidebar navigation (`spaces.list`) list the caller's spaces from **every** organization they belong to (today it lists only the current space's organization), pins "New private space" to the user's personal organization (so creating a private space while a team space is active never puts it in the team org), and lets the owner delete a team space (which also deletes its organization). On web, the Create menu and command palette gain **New team space**, which reuses the existing new-space name dialog and calls `spaces.createTeam`.

## Team space model (already decided; do not change)

- A team space lives in its own `Organization` (the "team organization"), created with it. The org holds exactly one space in v1, so `Member` rows and `SpaceMember` rows of that org are the same people with the same role.
- `Space.kind` is `"private"` (default) or `"team"`. Team spaces are created with `isDefault: false`; the user's personal default space stays their default.
- Roles are `"owner"` and `"member"` on both `Member.role` and `SpaceMember.role`, kept equal.
- Members can invite, cancel invites, and create/edit/delete any bot, routine, credential or connection. Only owners remove members, change roles, and delete the space. Any member can manage the team plan and billing (audited).
- Everything in a team space is visible to every member. Personal data (voice, model preferences, AI-data consent, notification preferences, push tokens, devices, personal model credentials) stays per user.
- Private spaces have one member, so space scoping must behave exactly as before for them.


## Context: files to read before implementing

- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` lines 217-235 (`Organization`), 339-353 (`Member`), 355-421 (`Space`), 436-455 (`SpaceMember`) — models this slice extends.
- `packages/db/src/spaces.ts` (whole file, 579 lines) — `createSpace` (83-103), `createSpaceDefaults` (105-124), `normalizeSpaceName`, `createSpaceForMember` (133-185, Serializable + `withTransactionRetry`), `loadActorSpace`, `assertSpaceDeletable` (owner, non-default, not last in org), `claimSpaceDeletionForMember`, `deleteClaimedSpaceForMember`, `personalOrganizationIds`.
- `packages/db/src/bootstrap-user.ts` lines 19-119 — how the personal org is created: `{ id: orgId, name: "Personal", slug: "user-<id[0:12]>" }`, member role `owner`, default space `id = orgId`, `isDefault: true`. Idempotent via P2002.
- `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20260830200000_space_scope_names_and_user_credentials/migration.sql` lines 46-71 — trigger `member_default_space_membership`: AFTER INSERT ON `member` inserts a `space_members` row for the org's **default** space. Team orgs have no default space, so it inserts nothing for them; the team `SpaceMember` row must be created explicitly.
- `packages/db/src/scope.ts` lines 19-45 — `requireMembership` orders by `space.isDefault desc`, then membership `createdAt`. Team spaces are `isDefault: false`, so a request without `x-rakazo-space-id` keeps landing in the personal space. Do not change this.
- `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts` lines 239 (`spaceName`), 307-316 (`spaces` contract).
- `packages/contracts/src/domain.ts` lines 328-345 (`SpaceSchema`), 347+ (`SpaceNavigationSchema`).
- `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts` — `asMemberOf` (35-47), `create` (65-100, error mapping + `recordAuditEvent({ action: "space.created", ... })`), `rename` (102-134), `remove` (137-180), `spaceNavigationDto` (217-226), `memberSpaceNavigation` (228-356; filters memberships by `organizationId: currentSpace.organizationId` at 239-247; computes `canRename`/`canDelete` at 315-320).
- `apps/api/src/space-deletion.ts` — `deleteSpaceWithContent`, the teardown used by `remove`.
- `apps/api/src/spaces-rename.test.ts` lines 21-82 — router test with a fake prisma and `RPCHandler`.
- `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts` lines 10-75 and `apps/api/src/space-availability.postgres.test.ts` lines 46-79 — Postgres router tests with fixtures in `runAsSystem`.
- `packages/db/src/audit-events.ts` lines 19-72 — `recordAuditEvent` input shape; never throws.
- Web: `apps/web/src/pages/shell/bot-picker.tsx` lines 88-103 (`create-new-space` item), `apps/web/src/pages/shell/sidebar-header.tsx` lines 124-165 (Create popover, `onCreateSpace`), `apps/web/src/pages/Shell.tsx` lines 727-732 (command palette `new-space`), `apps/web/src/pages/shell/shell-dialogs.tsx` lines 79 and 371-391 (`newSpaceOpen`, `<NewSpaceDialog onCreate=...>`), `apps/web/src/pages/shell/dialogs.tsx` line 37 (`NewSpaceDialog`).
- `apps/web/e2e/spaces.spec.ts` and `apps/web/e2e/helpers.ts` lines 184-187 (`openNewSpace`) — e2e pattern.
- `docs/spaces.md` — user docs to update.

## Patterns to follow

**Transactions:** mirror `createSpaceForMember` — `withTransactionRetry(() => prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {...}, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.Serializable }))`.

**Error mapping (routes/spaces.ts):**
```ts
if (error instanceof SpaceLimitError || error instanceof InvalidSpaceNameError) {
  throw new ORPCError("BAD_REQUEST", { message: error.message });
}
```
`SpaceNotFoundError` → `NOT_FOUND`; `Cannot*AsNonOwnerError` → `FORBIDDEN`; `SpaceDeletionInProgressError` → `CONFLICT`.

**Audit:**
```ts
await recordAuditEvent({ action: "space.created", actor: { type: "user", id: context.actor.userId },
  spaceId: space.id, target: { type: "space", id: space.id, label: space.name }, metadata: { kind: "team" } });
```

**Router test:** `createRouterClient(createRouter(deps as unknown as RouterDeps), { context: { actor } })` (see `apps/api/src/router.test.ts:116`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261111120000_team_spaces/migration.sql`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `ALTER TABLE "spaces" ADD COLUMN "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'private';` First line `-- Additive: older releases never read this column.`
- **GOTCHA**: no other schema change here; invitations get their own migration in another task.

### UPDATE `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma`

- **IMPLEMENT**: on `Space` add `kind String @default("private")` with a `///` doc comment: `"private" or "team"; a team space is the only space of its own organization.`
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm db:generate`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/spaces.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `createTeamSpace(prisma, { userId, name }): Promise<{ id: string; name: string; organizationId: string }>`:
  - `normalizeSpaceName(name)`; ids via `randomUUID()` for org, member, space, spaceMember.
  - Serializable transaction: limit check — count the user's `member` rows in organizations whose spaces are `kind: "team"`; throw `SpaceLimitError` at `MAX_SPACES_PER_MEMBER` (32).
  - Create `organization` `{ id, name, slug: "team-" + id.slice(0, 12), createdAt }`, `member` `{ role: "owner" }`, `space` `{ kind: "team", isDefault: false, createdByUserId: userId }` and the owner `spaceMember` (reuse `createSpace` by adding a `kind` field to `CreateSpaceInput`), then `createSpaceDefaults(tx, { spaceId, userId, memoryContent: "# Space memory\n\n" })`.
- **IMPLEMENT** `personalOrganizationIdForUser(prisma, userId)`: the organization of the user's `isDefault` space membership (`spaceMember.findFirst({ where: { userId, space: { isDefault: true } } })`). Change `createSpaceForMember` to create private spaces in that organization instead of `currentMembership.organizationId`, still checking the current membership exists (throw `IsolationError` if not).
- **IMPLEMENT** team deletion rules in `assertSpaceDeletable`: load `space.kind`; for `kind === "team"` skip the `CannotDeleteDefaultSpaceError` and `CannotDeleteLastSpaceError` checks (owner check stays). In `deleteClaimedSpaceForMember`, when the deleted space is a team space, delete its organization in the same transaction (`tx.organization.delete({ where: { id: organizationId } })`, cascades members, billing, credits, invitations), and when it was the active space return the user's personal default space id as the fallback.
- **GOTCHA**: `loadActorSpace` requires the target space to be in the same org as the current space; relax it so the target only needs the caller's own membership (`spaceMember` on `(spaceId, userId)`); the current-space membership check stays.
- **GOTCHA**: `personalOrganizationIds` (account deletion) already treats a team org with one member as personal; leave it.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/db check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/index.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: export `createTeamSpace` (and anything new) from the package index, next to the existing spaces exports.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/domain.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: on `SpaceSchema` add `kind: z.enum(["private", "team"]).default("private")` and `role: z.enum(["owner", "member"]).optional()` (the caller's role). Export `SpaceKindSchema`.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in `spaces` add `createTeam: oc.input(z.object({ name: spaceName })).output(z.object({ spaceId: Id }))`.

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** `createTeam` handler: inside `runAsSystem("create team space", ...)` call `createTeamSpace(deps.prisma, { userId: context.actor.userId, name: input.name })`; map `SpaceLimitError`/`InvalidSpaceNameError` to `BAD_REQUEST`; record `space.created` audit with `metadata: { kind: "team" }`; return `{ spaceId }`.
- **IMPLEMENT** in `memberSpaceNavigation`: list memberships with `where: { userId: actor.userId }` (all organizations), keeping `orderBy: { createdAt: "asc" }`; select `space.kind` and the membership `role`; set `kind` and `role` on each `Space`. `canDelete` for team spaces is `role === "owner"` (no default/last-space rules). Keep everything else unchanged for private spaces.
- **GOTCHA**: `spaces.remove` must still work for a team space; `space.deleted` audit must pass `organizationId` read before deletion (already done at 151-158).
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### CREATE `apps/api/src/team-spaces.postgres.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT** (pattern: `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts`): fixtures create a user with a bootstrapped personal org and default space (use `bootstrapUserSpace` from `@rakazo/db` or insert rows in `runAsSystem`). Cases:
  1. `spaces.createTeam({ name: "Payments team" })` creates a new organization, one `member` (owner), one `space` with `kind: "team"`, `isDefault: false`, one owner `spaceMember`, a `MEMORY.md` memory document; returns its id.
  2. `spaces.list` (actor in personal space) includes both the personal and team space; team entry has `kind: "team"`, `role: "owner"`, `canDelete: true`.
  3. Request without space header still resolves to the personal space (`requireMembership(prisma, userId)` returns the default space).
  4. With the team space active, `spaces.create({ name: "Side" })` creates the private space in the personal organization.
  5. `spaces.remove({ spaceId: team })` deletes the space and its organization, returns `activeSpaceId` = personal space id when the team space was active.
  6. Invalid name → `BAD_REQUEST`.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm test:integration -- --spec=team-spaces`

### UPDATE web: `apps/web/src/pages/shell/bot-picker.tsx`, `sidebar-header.tsx`, `shell-dialogs.tsx`, `Shell.tsx`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add a `CommandItem` right after `create-new-space` with `data-testid="create-new-team-space"`, an icon from the existing lucide set (e.g. `Users`), label `<Trans>New team space</Trans>`, and a `PickerInfo` tooltip only if the private item has one (keep it parallel: "Shared with people you invite."). Add `onCreateTeamSpace` prop, threaded like `onCreateSpace`, opening the same `NewSpaceDialog` in a team mode (state `newSpaceKind: "private" | "team"`). In team mode `onCreate` calls `rpc.spaces.createTeam({ name })` and returns `spaceId`; skip the availability step (`loadItems`/`chooseItems`) because team spaces start empty; on done `selectSpace(spaceId)` and navigate to `/app` (not onboarding). Add a command palette entry `{ id: "new-team-space", label: t\`New team space\`, ... }` next to `new-space` in `Shell.tsx:727-732`.
- **GOTCHA**: strings use Lingui; run `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web intl:extract` and fill every `apps/web/src/locales/*/messages.po` entry for the new strings.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web check && pnpm --filter @rakazo/web test`

### UPDATE `apps/web/e2e/spaces.spec.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: a test that signs up (`signup` helper), opens the Create menu (`create-menu-trigger`), clicks `create-new-team-space`, names it "Payments team", and asserts the sidebar shows a group `[data-sidebar-group^="space:"]` with that name; `captureScreenshot(page, testInfo, "team-space-created")`.

### UPDATE `docs/spaces.md`

- **IMPLEMENT**: one short section "Team spaces": Create → **New team space**; starts empty; everything inside is shared with its members; has its own plan and credits. Keep it brief.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /rpc/spaces/createTeam` `{ "json": { "name": "Payments team" } }` → `{ "json": { "spaceId": "<id>" } }`; new org + owner member + team space + owner space member exist.
- [ ] `spaces.list` returns spaces from all of the caller's organizations, each with `kind` and `role`.
- [ ] Private space creation always lands in the personal organization.
- [ ] Owner can delete a team space; its organization is deleted too; non-owner gets `FORBIDDEN`.
- [ ] Requests without a space header still use the personal default space.
- [ ] Web Create menu shows **New team space** and creates one.
- [ ] Existing private-space tests still pass unchanged.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src/spaces-rename.test.ts packages/db/src
pnpm --filter @rakazo/web test
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=team-spaces
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
